from pathlib import Path
import os,json,hashlib,datetime,re,stat
root=Path('/Users/robault/GitHub/sugata-avatar'); leaf=root/'docs/evidence/appearance-2026-10-19/preview-lifetime-owner'
print('PID',os.getpid(),'UTC',datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
pf=json.loads((leaf/'PREFLIGHT.json').read_text()); checked=[]
for row in pf['inputs']:
 p=Path(row['path']);b=p.read_bytes()
 assert len(b)==row['bytes'] and sha(b)==row['sha256'],str(p)
 checked.append({'path':str(p),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':sha(b)})
